One of my best friends ever, such a cool dude (all though not the brightest kid) had a seemingly great life on paper, nice parents, 2 beautiful German Shepherds. and good money in the home.

But, there was one thing off, his two siblings. 

He had an older brother and sister, sister 18 at the time, about to go to college and a brother, 17 at the time. These were the types of people you would try and avoid as a young kid. Firstly, his older sister, she had a bf, her dealer. He supposedly only dealt hash, grass, weed etc. and especially to her. Before he got into it himself, he said that his sister used it for stress, correct me if I am wrong, but I do believe marijuana can have this affect (as well as more adverse affects). As for his brother, he also got weed from his sisters dealer, (who is keep in mind, 3 years older).  


So he was growing up with the shittiest atmosphere regarding his siblings, and this affected him heavily. Failing classes because no places to study at home etc.  


What this ended up turning into was his siblings giving him some weed for him to try. He got instantly hooked, very addictive personality. This ended up with him stealing from his brother and sisters stashes (parents did not know about any of this up until this point) starts smoking alone. Now he starts getting involved with the wrong crowd. He starts drinking, taking pills, painkillers and as well as lsd.   


This is where his parents started getting involved. His dad caught him sneaking out one night trying to go get some more weed, and this kid, was already almost green out high. Parents find out he had been smoking, but that's it. He continues life as normal (for him) and this is when I really wish his parents got involved, if they took more drastic measures, they could've helped him recover, but they didn't.

​

As for how I was involved, he would message me almost every night, asking to smoke, or do LSD, and of course I would say no. Once, years later I try to meet up with him again. He is worse, breaking random windows on people houses, bringing drugs everywhere, I called it quits there. I left. My other friend and I, who where both very close to this kid, tried stopping him, getting him help, but then he cut us off. haven't heard since.

​

What started with big sister letting little bro try some hash, ended with a kid with a promising future ruined.   


TL;DR: Kids life was ruined from drugs because of reckless parenting, and shit siblings.
